morphology.pattern_note: 独立词根，无词缀音变；ng 表示单一鼻音 /ŋ/，不是 /nɡ/。

senses.zh_definition: 动作敏捷、灵活而迅速的。
senses.en_definition: Agile, nimble, or quick in movement.
senses.ms_definition: Cepat gerak-gerinya; cekatan, cergas dan pantas.
senses.nuances: 强调动作速度与协调性，常形容运动员、动物或手部动作；不单指交通工具行驶速度。语义依据：[DBP：tangkas](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=tangkas)。

senses.zh_definition: 机敏、活跃，行动利落而反应迅速的。
senses.en_definition: Alert, vigorous, and quick to act.
senses.ms_definition: Gesit, giat dan sigap ketika bertindak.
senses.nuances: 与动作敏捷义相连，但侧重行动中的干练与迅速应对；不能直接等同于聪明或学识丰富。

dual_scenarios.ms: Penjaga gol negara tangkas menepis rembatan itu pada minit terakhir perlawanan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 国家队守门员在比赛最后一分钟敏捷地扑出了那记射门。
dual_scenarios.en: The national goalkeeper deftly parried the shot in the final minute of the match.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Tangkas betul penjaga gol tu, bola dekat sangat pun dia sempat tepis!
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Penjaga gol itu sangat tangkas; walaupun bola begitu dekat, dia masih sempat menepisnya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 那个守门员身手真快，球都那么近了，他还来得及扑出去！
dual_scenarios.en: That keeper’s so quick—even from that close, he managed to parry it!
spoken_features: tu 是 itu 的口语缩略形式。
betul 放在形容词后加强语气，相当于“真……”。
pun 在此突出“即使这样也……”的意外感。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah tengok video penjaga gol tu? Tangkas betul dia!
messages.ms_standard: Awak sudah menonton video penjaga gol itu? Dia sangat tangkas!
messages.zh: 你看过那个守门员的视频了吗？他身手真敏捷！
messages.en: Have you seen that keeper’s video? His reflexes are amazing!

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, aku tengok kat telefon tadi. Bola dekat macam tu pun dia sempat tepis!
messages.ms_standard: Sudah, saya menontonnya melalui telefon tadi. Walaupun bola begitu dekat, dia masih sempat menepisnya!
messages.zh: 看了，刚才用手机看的。球都那么近了，他还来得及扑出去！
messages.en: Yeah, I watched it on my phone earlier. He still got a hand to it from that close!

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan illustrates tangkas with two warriors whose abilities are evenly matched. That image captures more than speed: an effective fighter must coordinate movement, timing, and readiness. The same semantic core makes the word useful for describing a goalkeeper or a deft pair of hands. No earlier source language or dated origin is established by the supplied evidence. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=tangkas)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tang-kas 想成两拍闪躲：左闪 tang，右避 kas——动作又快又灵活。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 属于中性褒义词，适合称赞运动表现、操作技巧或应变能力；正式评价宜指出具体表现。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 可用于体育、救援和工作表现。对长者或行动不便者，不宜用“不够 tangkas”作当面比较，以免显得轻视其身体能力。
